channel.title: Long Island Business News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Long Island Business News (libn.com)

item.title: Cantor: Tariffs, free trade and the U.S. economy: Can they all exist together?
item.description: U.S. tariffs aimed at reducing trade deficits showed mixed results in 2025, with slight improvements in trade balance and early signs of manufacturing growth.

item.title: Chu, Herbst: One year in, congestion pricing is working for Long Island
item.description: Congestion pricing on Long Island has reduced traffic, improved air quality, and increased LIRR ridership while funding critical transit infrastructure upgrades.

item.title: How law professionals can advance careers through firm support and education
item.description: Law professionals can achieve promotion by demonstrating leadership, business acumen, and leveraging educational and firm support programs that foster career growth.

item.title: Farmingdale State launches Master of Science in Construction Management
item.description: Farmingdale State College introduces a Master of Science in Construction Management to prepare leaders for tech-driven construction projects. Applications open for fall 2026.

item.title: Broxmeyer acquires Lynbrook apartment property for $36M
item.description: An affiliate of Gary Broxmeyer acquired the 80-unit Cornerstone at Yorkshire apartment property in Lynbrook for $36 million, down from its previous $42.85 million sale.

item.title: Exhibit showcases Suffolk law enforcement history
item.description: The Suffolk County Sheriff’s Office history exhibit, featuring artifacts and photos, is now open at Riverhead Town Hall, highlighting the agency's legacy since 1683.

item.title: AARP New York urges more support for LI family caregivers
item.description: AARP New York's report highlights the financial strain on Long Island family caregivers and recommends policies to support affordable housing and caregiver benefits.

item.title: New Chick-fil-A restaurant opening in Bohemia
item.description: Chick-fil-A opens a new 5,500-square-foot restaurant in Bohemia on March 5.

item.title: Lessing’s opens Shoreline Café at Good Samaritan Hospital in West Islip
item.description: Lessing’s Hospitality Group has launched the Shoreline Café at Catholic Health’s Good Samaritan University Hospital, offering chef-driven menus for guests and staff.

item.title: Carco DMV Services expands with new Huntington Branch
